notes.title: V1.3.22
notes.notes:
The following is a list of updates for Time-Skip:

-Resolved controller button layout & sensitivity changes
-Resolved shadow quality
-Fixed several ledges the player was capable of standing on
-Changes to pause menu and tutorial text
-Added 32-bit version. Why was it 64-bit, you may ask? Each update requires the game to be re-created yet again. So now with 2 versions, 64 & 32 bit each update will require the game to be updated twice, (once for each version)

notes.title: Quick Fix 1.2.4
notes.notes:
Played through the current version of 'Time Skip' V 1.2.4 on Steam from start to finish, and it's fun! 
Several puzzles created a while ago still prove to be fun & interesting challenges during testing for the developer. So what's new in this update?

-Lighting improvements in added sections.

-2 New laser hazards

-Laser added to Main Menu.

-A new laser hazard added in the previous version seemed to be working in game engine, but failed to move properly when the exe file was built. I'm going to speak to the engine company about this and make a video log detailing the error that I feel I am not responsible for. I've found another solution to this, but is not as efficient in coding. Very strange the engine program is doing this. In-game error solved.

-Added more props and 1 material.

-Increased turret damage by about 200%

-Slightly increased teleport accuracy.

So basically the game handles great and is fun to play! I have a few more puzzle ideas I'm going to write them down and try to fit them into later levels. 
But honestly this game needs more good reviews. 'Time Skip' is still new and capable of changes, so buy this game and contribute your ideas today!

notes.title: Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
About 25 updates later still adding content and finding/fixing errors. Most games usually do this often and for good reason. Spent all morning and night fixing errors in compile/build logs.



-New Engine Version* update was causing errors with load triggers, so if you were experiencing confusion within the last 15 days during V 1.2.0 of Time Skip that is the reason why level 2 had issues loading. A load trigger was not sensing the player.

-Deleted future character AI not yet referenced in-game due to errors crashing the game build.

-Added new laser traps & puzzles.

-Level 3 new section added.

*New versions have more features and post effects, as well as performance gains but can make changes to C++.

Final Patch Notes V 1.2.2: Time skip updated the game engine which invalidated some characters causing load issues within last 2 weeks. It was completely unintentional if this was an inconvenience and has been resolved, thank you.
